change: 32x32 array with DSP packing (2 INT8 MAC / DSP48E2)
what: 4x MACs for ~2x DSPs; UB/ACC/WFIFO widths double. Needs packing correction logic.
Pipeline DSPs (A/B/M/P regs), register the requant/VPU multipliers, retime decoder legality checks. DDR latency in cycles doubles.

change: Streamlined control (requant-param table, no per-tile SYNC, ACT overlaps)
what: Per-layer requant table indexed by column tile (1 instr instead of 2C+1 SET_CONFIG), SET_CONFIG no longer waits for ACTIVATE, ACC ping-pong without SYNC(MATRIX) per tile, GELU as an activation-unit LUT. Decoder/act_seq + compiler change, ~0 resources.

change: VPU integrated, pipelined and overlapped with the array
what: VECTOR opcode with its own UB ports so LayerNorm/softmax/residual run while the array computes the next GEMM; isqrt/divide of one job overlap the next job's rows.

Second shadow register bank per PE, loaded alternately: the next tile loads while the previous one waits for its swap. Min tile period (2R+C+1)/2 instead of 2R+C+1 (49 vs 97 cycles at 32x32), i.e. 64-token tiles stop stalling.
Only for models <= ~1.5 MB INT8: preload weights into URAM once (UB cut to 256 KiB).

change: Decoupled weight prefetch DMA (large bursts into the Weight FIFO)
what: A weight-stream engine that runs ahead of MATMUL bounded by FIFO space, one DMA per layer instead of one 256 B READ_WEIGHTS per tile. Hides DDR latency.

change: UB -> weight-loader path for Q.K^T / P.V
what: Read K/V tiles from the UB into the weight shift chain (with transpose for K^T) instead of a DDR round trip. One mux + address generator.
